assessment.governing_intent: WO-220607/#139 is a replacement gate for Node/bootstrap execution authority: after all named predecessor proofs are complete, bind an approved live profile and single-writer cutover path, reconcile active work and external effects, retain checkpoint/rollback protection, prove Node-independent live self-hosting and the full required suite, and only then consider retirement of the Node/bootstrap writer.
assessment.summary: The packet is not READY. The binding Wave 2 authority decision appears to dispose the recurring authority gates it names for approved Wave 2 work within bounds, including POSTW1-DECIDE-006A, live transport proof, sovereignty cutover, future release, SWF-21 scope, and attention activation. However, this BIU still depends on predecessor completions and accepted proof that are explicitly reported as not done, lacks a bound live profile/window/operational target and associated custody/budget, has no operational proof run, and may still retain a separate RESIDENT_TENURE_DECISION gate not disposed by the cited binding decision.
implementation_unknowns: Exact live operational commands, target profile, writer epoch, and cutover window are not specified in the packet and are explicitly marked UNBOUND.

How the implementer will inventory active Node claims, external effects, checkpoint manifests, rollback state, and refusal counts remains to be worked out at implementation time once the live target is bound.
The exact predecessor candidate/proof receipt identities to be consumed are unavailable until the predecessors are accepted as DONE.
The packet reports local isolated probe results, but this assessment does not independently verify those results or repository contents.
assessment.verification_assessment: Local probes are described and appear useful as preparatory discrimination, but the stated acceptance predicate is operational: accepted predecessor proofs, an authorized live profile, one-writer admission, Node refusal for the same work, Python-controlled live self-hosting, checkpoint/rollback without redispatch, full required suite, readback continuity, and independent verdict. One independent readiness verdict is meaningful only after those external prerequisites and live proof conditions are available; at present the observable acceptance cannot be satisfied from the supplied packet.
material_risks: #135/R3, #136/R4, #137/R5, and #132/B6 are reported not DONE, so their capabilities are not available execution substrate.
No specific live cutover target, window, profile, budget, or custody is bound.
The Node/bootstrap writer must remain in place; premature retirement could violate KEEP_UNTIL_REPLACED and no-loss/no-duplicate-effect protections.
Operational success cannot be inferred from isolated local probes.
A remaining RESIDENT_TENURE_DECISION authority gate is listed in the packet and is not explicitly disposed by the provided binding decision.
Dual writer or redispatch errors would create material external-effect risk if cutover is attempted without predecessor proof and one-writer controls.
assessment.next_action: Keep #139 on HOLD; narrow the hold to the specific remaining gates: accepted completion proof for all named predecessors, bound authorized live profile/window/budget/custody, resolution or confirmation of any retained RESIDENT_TENURE_DECISION gate, and successful operational proof with independent verdict.
assessment.rationale: The controlling condition is not unclear intent or task size; the intended capstone gate is coherent. The blocker is unavailable prerequisites and operational authority/custody needed to run the required live proof. The provided Wave 2 binding decision resolves several recurring authority questions and should not be reopened, but it expressly preserves dependency proof, target binding, custody, evidence, one-writer safety, rollback/readback, and independent verification. The packet itself states TASKS is not READY, predecessors remain incomplete, live commands and target are unbound, and no operational case has run.
